workflow.name: go_to_market
workflow.title: Go-to-market studio
workflow.description: Unify business strategy, positioning, launch planning, and user acquisition into one evidence-aware operating plan.

phases.title: Positioning
phases.purpose: Define the category, specific audience, urgent job, alternatives, differentiated promise, proof, pricing hypothesis, and claims that still require evidence. Keep customer fact, assumption, and strategic choice visibly separate.

phases.title: Launch plan
phases.purpose: Build a sequenced launch plan with audience segments, messages, channels, owned assets, responsible owners, dates or relative milestones, budget assumptions, measurable leading and lagging indicators, and stop/continue criteria.
